desc: "The Earl" is a five-shot, single action, 1860's- styled mini- revolver chambered in 22 magnum. Named after the NAA gunsmith who originally developed the product, with it's faux loading lever (which secures the cylinder pin), "The Earl" resembles a 150 year old percussion revolver then common in the Old West. With it's heavy octagonal barrel, top strap channel and bead front sight, "The Earl" could become your favorite plinker (pray for the snake, rodent, or tin can that dares cross your path!). With available flap-holster made of belt grade leather, strap on "The Earl" for an imaginative trip back to a simpler time.
